metadata.name: ODIClient
metadata.description: Press L for ODIClient: hold Tab for a compact player roster with skin heads, selected 3D skin previews, and local PNG saves; Lobby Scanner commands with optional yes/no confirmation, player-hit Particles, Zoom, Auto Sprint, Motion Blur, screen blur, FPS Display with optional 1% low, font scales, and corner anchoring, FPS Limit, experimental Render limits, Environment time changer, HSV fog color and Physically inspired sky with always-enabled GPU atmosphere optimizations, AutoGG, CC Utils party invite confirmations and Shift/right-click player ping, Chat mods with a message blacklist, and shared yes/no confirmations. Targets launcher 1.8.4 SDL3/Wayland and EGLUT/X11; native hooks support Minecraft 1.26.52.3 Android x86_64.
